title: Hypothetical example: produce a purchase-unit BOM for every sold option combination
hypothetical_notice: Illustration only, invented end to end. No estate was observed; this record is NOT evidence of any real firm, routine or output. It exists to exercise the schema's claim/choice/cross_output_consistency/coverage/reconciliation shapes for a future option->BOM estate. All invented content is marked [HYPOTHETICAL].

behaviour.statement: [HYPOTHETICAL] The estate solves a lot as an option set (Boolean compatibility rules over two scopes), then writes the BOM by counting block inserts in the solved drawing.
behaviour.note: No recorded runs; the behaviour statement itself is invented.

evidence.detail: [HYPOTHETICAL] A released BOM for one sold lot exists in the story; no real artifact.
[HYPOTHETICAL] The estate owner states in the story that the BOM writer ran on every lot. Capped at medium confidence by the schema (owner statements never reach high).

purpose.statement: [HYPOTHETICAL] Candidate: the estate exists so that every sold option combination yields a consistent, purchase-ready materials list without re-keying geometry into estimating. Beneficiary: the firm's purchasing.
purpose.note: Even inside the story there is no process-owner ruling; matching outputs would never confirm this purpose (LOG-0023).

authority.basis_note: [HYPOTHETICAL] Option and BOM conventions are the firm's own choices.

concerns.statement: The BOM lists purchase units for the selected option set.
An option set is only solved when all compatibility rules pass (the '-SOLVED' state).
Option selections are stored as block attributes in the drawing.
Quantities are derived by counting block inserts in the solved drawing.

choices.statement: [HYPOTHETICAL] A garage may be selected or not, per the catalogue.
choices.note: [HYPOTHETICAL] Catalogue-availability scope: what can be sold at all.

choices.statement: [HYPOTHETICAL] Selecting the garage requires the wide door type.
choices.note: [HYPOTHETICAL] Object-rule scope: what must change inside the document when a choice is made. Open, so it must surface in pending_user.

cross_output_consistency.invariant: [HYPOTHETICAL] BOM type counts equal the counts derived from the same solved drawing.
cross_output_consistency.read_back: [HYPOTHETICAL] Re-derive counts from the released solved drawing; compare with the released BOM; differences must be explained.

cross_output_consistency.invariant: [HYPOTHETICAL] The option list attached to the contract equals the option set recorded in the solved drawing.
cross_output_consistency.read_back: [HYPOTHETICAL] Read back both artifacts and compare as sets.

acceptance.basis: [HYPOTHETICAL] Released historical lot documents (plans + BOM) as reference outputs.
acceptance.element_scope: [HYPOTHETICAL] Blocks/objects counted by the BOM writer; elements outside its scope (e.g. annotations) excluded and stated.

reconciliation.description: [HYPOTHETICAL] One historical lot: standard plan with garage and fireplace selected.

coverage.what: [HYPOTHETICAL] Compatibility checking between selected options (the solve step).
coverage.reason: [HYPOTHETICAL] No successor selected; even where a target platform offers configuration mechanisms, native coverage would require versioned primary-source evidence and a purpose ruling.

coverage.what: [HYPOTHETICAL] BOM generation from the solved geometry.
coverage.reason: [HYPOTHETICAL] Live schedules in a BIM tool are a candidate native coverage; not claimed without versioned evidence and ruling.

evidence.detail: [HYPOTHETICAL] Illustrates the evidence kind a future record would use: a versioned primary source naming the platform feature.
evidence.source_ref: https://help.autodesk.com/view/RVT/2024/ENU/ (illustrative pointer only, not a recorded coverage proof)

coverage.what: [HYPOTHETICAL] Regenerating the layer table before extraction.
coverage.reason: [HYPOTHETICAL] Drafting housekeeping assumed covered natively by any modern target; kept here only as a format example of a retire item with reason and authority.

coverage.what: [HYPOTHETICAL] Waste factors applied to purchase units.
coverage.reason: [HYPOTHETICAL] Known in the story to live in a spreadsheet outside the estate; recorded so it is never silent.

pending_user: [HYPOTHETICAL] Purpose ruling by a named process owner: none exists even in the story.
[HYPOTHETICAL] The open compatibility rule (COMP-GARAGE-DOOR) blocks any binding output that depends on it until decided.
